blocks.text: Real-world analogue: Barrier islands, tidal flats, long sandbars, seasonal beaches, and shorelines rebuilt by storms. A familiar coast is never physically identical between tides even when its pattern returns.
World relation: Wild World succession and Quiet World attention to small change. Continuity exists in rhythm rather than unchanging material.
Connection to newer locations: It connects to the Basalt Memory Coast, Archipelago of Borrowed Horizons, Inland Sea of Doors, and Mirror-Save Shore.
Abstract or metaphorical relation: Recurrence is not worthlessness. The same meal, game, tide, walk, or act of care can matter again because the participants and relationships are not static copies.
